verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows API/CLI endpoints for retrieving specific payroll, employee, and contractor data (GET endpoints, CLI commands, MCP read access) but no documented bulk/full data export feature in open, portable formats intended for a user to take their data and leave Gusto. One community comment (gusto-comm-4) even flags platform lock-in for certain features, but there's no concrete vendor claim of comprehensive data export to dispute.
